translation: Not poisonous. It nourishes liver and gallbladder qi, calms the five viscera, settles the intention, boosts essence, benefits the nine orifices, dispels latent heat, [treats] intestinal [qi], stops thirst, sobers from wine, [treats] red urine, cures foul ulcers and lower-body worms (下部慝), levels stomach qi, makes one fond of eating, and lightens the body.
